SPECIFICATIONS ...........19 Page 4 of 20 Design Basis Memorandum 1997-000-PL-DBM-0001 Revision: 0 Pipeline Scope - FEED Date: April 28, 2023 1 INTRODUCTION This Design Basis Memorandum (DBM) establishes the basis for key functional and technical design parameters and information for use in the design and engineering of the Trimeric One Earth Sequestration (OES) CO2 Pipeline Project, specific to the Pipeline scope of design. The DBM will be revised as required to include the latest pipeline design-related information as needed. In addition to providing essential technical documentation for the project, this DBM shall guide the Company and its project team in their work activities and production of engineering and design deliverables. 1.1 PROJECT OVERVIEW OES plans to develop a new CO capture, transportation, and sequestration system. The Project will 2 capture CO from 2 sources In Illinois Northwest of Gibson City and deliver the CO to three injection 2 2 sites in Illinois Southeast of Anchor city for permanent geological sequestration. Initially the project will source CO from ethanol production facilities. 2 CO from each source will be captured, dehydrated, and compressed to pipeline‐quality dense phase 2 conditions for injection into the pipeline system. The mainline pipeline will run from Westest of Gibson City to the area Southeast of Anchor city, where the pipeline will deliver CO to multiple injection wells 2 for permanent geologic sequestration. 1.2 SCOPE OF WORK The scope of work for the Project addressed within this design basis is the engineering and design, right of way (ROW) services, civil survey services, and environmental services associated with the project objectives. The battery limits of this scope basis document are the outlet flange of the OES meter run into the PL and the inlet flange of the delivery meter at each sequestration well, if said meter exists. Otherwise, the scope ends at the wellhead wing valve.
